name: My Plugins
author: David Reed
description: A bar dashboard of the Omarchy plugins you own: marketplace views, hearts, and install-command copies, plus GitHub stars and verification. Filters the public catalog to your GitHub user (auto-detected from plugins already on this machine, or set githubUser). Unlisted local plugins still appear, without fake stats. Copies are marketplace command copies, not installs.

barWidget.description: Views, hearts, and copies for the Omarchy plugins you publish. The pill shows how many you have listed; the popup is the per-plugin breakdown.
